channel.title: Cheryl's Newscast
channel.description: Three short news briefings a day — morning, midday, evening — read by Cheryl Tunt in her trademark deadpan. Private feed.
channel.itunes:author: Topher

item.title: Midday briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Trump claims Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" effective immediately • Houthi missile attack kills 12 at Riyadh airport; Saudis close it • Estonia blames Russia for arson at defense supplier • Russia cagey about suspected plague case in Moscow • US-Zambia sign $2.49B health financing pact • Tehran tells Americans directly that "Trump's war has failed" • Trump to decide on livestreaming Nidal Hasan execution • Unhinged fun fact: 57 new deep-sea species off Argentina, including a Patrick Star lookalike • Ukrainian drone strikes cripple Yandex data centers • Nvidia discontinues the RTX 5090 to feed data centers • AI-assisted Daytona USA PC port dev: "Claude turns months into weeks" • New releases: Citadel Forged with Fire; Age of Empires IV Raiders of the North • Homelab corner: Let's Encrypt shortening certs to 64 days in 2027 • Stocks: markets closed Sunday; Datadog at fresh 52-week high • Lowell corner: MAPS loses $214K federal grant for domestic violence program

item.title: Morning briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Erie, PA mass shooting: nine killed, suspected shooter found dead • Stolen car nearly hits the Melbourne Marathon course • Two major earthquakes in Panama, 7.7 and 6.6 • Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay • Turkey bans under-15s from social media • DOJ opens antitrust probe into TV networks' pool-coverage boycott • US sanctions the International Criminal Court • Tax-exempt dyed diesel for farmers through year's end • Unhinged fun fact: 2,700 cats stolen in Ho Chi Minh City • Nadella says treat every AI model as compromised; White House requires AI incident reporting • AI boom squeezes hardware: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro orders, PC shipments down, Tencent leases chips • Atari 2600 turns 50 • This week's releases: Dragon's Dogma 2 Dark Arisen, Valor Mortis, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Enshrouded 1.0, Ratatan • Homelab corner: Proxmox wired into Home Assistant • OpenAI shutting down its TTS API models in January 2027 • Stocks, Datadog included • Lowell corner: two fire stations closed in staffing crunch • Draper breaks ground on Lowell's IMPACT Center microelectronics building
